finding: Children with CP born SGA have different clinical factors and phenotypic profiles than other children with CP, including higher frequencies of maternal African-American ethnicity, intrauterine infections, gestational hypertension, smaller head circumference at birth, emergency cesarean section, birth asphyxia, placental abnormalities, and greater motor and communication impairment.
mod_finding: Children with CP born SGA had a higher frequency of emergency cesarean section compared to other children with CP.
birth_weight: Birth weight below the tenth percentile for gestational age and sex
